label: Sustaining-dependence and onset-parity controls: parent and child, omissions and nonvacuity
paraphrase: Closed controls on interpretations with one world, natural-number times and two individuals; statements about these interpretations only. (1) Parent and child: true is present at times 0 and 1 and gives false being at time 1 only; false persists from time 1 on; dependence read as co-presence in every history. The contact principle, the co-presence bridge and the sustaining sibling hold; the weak sustaining reading ce55210c and the esse-dependence premise 2068f91c fail. (2) true present always, giving false being from time 1 on, no dependence: the weak sustaining reading and contact hold; the bridge, the sibling and 2068f91c fail. (3) An absent giver giving at every time, dependence as co-presence: the weak sustaining reading and the bridge hold; contact, the sibling and 2068f91c fail. (4) As (2) with dependence as co-presence: every premise, the sibling and 2068f91c hold, and false depends on true. (5) The inertial history of (1), false alone with received esse: onset is given; parity and concurrent actualization for begun things fail. (6) The same history with no giving: parity holds vacuously; onset and concurrent actualization for begun things fail. (7) The history of (2): onset, parity and concurrent actualization for begun things hold.
